body:
Application

Age: 15

Time zone: GMT

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: yes 

Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: yes

Do you have access to recording software? Yes/No: yes

 

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

 

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?

 

I do not have any experience as staff member but I am a quick learner so I highly doubt that this will affect me as Moderator.

 

 

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?

 

In my opinion my biggest weakness is my lack of patience whether it is waiting for someone or something, I doubt this will affect my moderating though as I know that I am getting better as I get older.

 

 

However, I believe my biggest strength is my communication skills I do many clubs outside of school all of which involve communication such as Royal Marine Cadets this is where communication is key, as you can imagine all types of forces revolve around communication. I know this will affect my moderating in a positive way as it always good to know how to put your views and points across to people.

 

 

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

 

In my opinion my activity is the biggest improvement I can bring to the server as there are always rule breakers on during my time online, as well as this I hope I can bring happiness to the staff team, this may sound a bit cringe but I am always happy and quite good at making the best out of bad situations.

 

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

 

In my opinion a leader needs to be good at getting his points and commands across to the people he is talking to, so his communication skills and confidence are a major part of being a leader, I personally do consider myself to be a good leader as you may have seen I am the founder of NewDawn, this team was previously known as BackSpace and I was put in charge of it and I turned it around and now 23 days later it is the third largest team, scrimming weekly and full of good players. I am in charge of this team with 3 other helpers and we successfully manage to get around 20 players on weekly to scrim, the others turn up next week. I believe this shows my ability to lead a large group of people.

 

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

 

I believe that my perseverance makes me stand out from the crowd, I know this as for four years I have been training to become a Black Belt in Taekwondo, I have been met with rough times, hard work and overall misery, it just got to the point that I hated going as I got to a boring bit where I couldn't keep up with the physical aspect of it. Any way long story short I got back up, dusted myself down and I pushed on I am currently going for my Black Belt pre-grading in two weeks due to all the hard work and effect I put in. This skill is what I know will distinguish me from the crowd as not many other people will put in the effort, mentally or physically as I will.

 

 

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

 

I believe that the skills you need to interact with people successfully are good communication skills and knowledge, put together these skills are a strong combination, I believe I have the knowledge and the communication skills to interact with the community, I already know a lot of people on the server due to my activity and how long I have been on the server for, regardless I still think I can interact well with the community as I have the knowledge of maps, events, people and most things Avicus.

 

 

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)?

 

I can commit a lot of time to being a staff member as Avicus is the only server I really go on unless lots of people are going to Hypixel then I may occasionally go on, otherwise 100% of my time on Minecraft is on Avicus.

 

 

 

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

 

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

 

If I was to be online during this incident, I would record the incident so evidence could be given if needed due to an appeal. I would then freeze the ban evader to stop the player from causing anymore havoc. I would note down the IGN of the player so I could then address a staff member through the staff discord, I would then give them the IGN of the player so they could ban him appropriately. The situation would be safely handled as the player is no longer able to hack as they are frozen, secondly the player will be banned as soon as a moderator is online. To go a step further I could request that the player was IP checked to stop any further rule breaking.

 

 

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on TeamSpeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

 

In this situation I would ping a senior moderator as they have the power and authority to deal with a misbehaving staff member, however in the mean time I would poke the staff member reminding him of the example he should be setting and how possible demotion may be a consequence if he continues, depending on the severity of the situation I would mute the staff member to stop him from disrupting the channel and I would wait for a senior moderator to arrive.

 

 

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?

 

In the unlikely situation that this would happen I would contact players that I know were online at the time, as they could be used as witnesses. Although I keep backups of my recordings for my YouTube videos, without the recording I would have to rely on either players who can back me up or the fact that I am a moderator and I am mature enough not to lie or alter the truth.

 

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

 

To start with I would screenshot the post so there is evidence of leaking, secondly I would delete the post straight away; even if it “isn’t very important” the community would know about it if they needed to know about it. The confidentiality of the post is not important, if the community aren’t supposed to know, it’s technically still leaking. After I delete the post I would contact the staff member and explain to them that leaking is punishable, after this I would contact a senior moderator and give the evidence, at this point the senior could assess the situation and decide whether or not it is punishment worthy.

 

 

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

 

In this situation I would contact the senior staff member on Discord or Slack and would politely ask for the reasoning behind the decision, I would express my concern towards the decision giving my viewpoints on the agreement, hopefully a compromise could be made if not then I would offer a compromise and discuss its pros and cons. At this point with good enough evidence I think the compromise could be reached, if this decision were to still go ahead I would privately inform the senior staff team of my concerns and worries and tell them that I know they will make best decision for the community.

 

 

CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.

 

 

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?

 

If I was to be accepted this would be a massive confidence boost due to the fact that I will start working soon so I need to be prepared to write CV’s and applications, if this was to be accepted I believe this would assure myself that I can achieve things if I try my best.

 

 

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?


Avicus is the only server I play on, apart from occasional trips to Hypixel. All my time is mostly on Avicus, now with being a leader of a team and being on the event staff team, I find myself on Avicus a lot, but I enjoy every minute of it!



Do you speak any other languages than English?


I understand some Spanish, but it is very limited, otherwise I am afraid I can’t.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?

 

I am 15 years old; I am a marine cadet, attending twice weekly. I recently won two awards at a Cadet Award ceremony, one for best marksman and the other for runner up best cadet.

 

I believe that being a Marine Cadet shows that I’m punctual, good with Authority and that I am determined.

 

Since 2011, every Wednesday and Sunday I attend Taekwondo practice, I am currently in the final stages of taking my Black belt qualification.  To have made it this far in the Taekwondo qualification process shows that I can persevere to achieve my goals.

 

Every Saturday I go to a local pool and continue with my Life Guard Training.  This is hard work and requires high fitness levels, but is worthwhile and once complete will have a positive effect on the community and myself.

 

I am active on the Avicus forums, community slack, staff discord, on the server and would be active on the community discord as well, If I had an invite…
